clips.title: The story
paras: Across Mulgore, Well Stones rest beside the water wells. Their earth and water magic helps prepare the Water of the Seers for tauren rites of passage.

Well Stones rest in the soft earth beside Mulgore’s wells, where they absorb the spiritual resonance of the plains and the waters beneath them. Shaman and seers such as Zarlman Two-Moons know these stones as vessels of vital magic, not ordinary river pebbles. Combined with grounded Ambercorn beneath the plains’ mighty trees, their mineral properties temper the brew that awakens visionary trances in young tauren during the sacred Rite of Vision.
